title: Barreras ukanakan lurayiripa
intro: Jachʼa oraqenak taypinjja, mä chʼamani jaqew walja expedicionanakar saräna, walja autoridadanaka ukat medionaka churapjjäna. Aka almax kunayman ayllunakampiw jikisi, ukatx jan uñt’at jan walt’awinakampiw uñjasi, sarnaqäwinakapamp iyawsäwimp mä wiñay chimpu jaytawayi, lurawinakapampi, yatiñanakapampix, taqi ukanakx chiqpach ch’amapan phunchhawip uñt’ayasa.
clues: Taqi kunat sipansa chʼamampi ukat yänakampi churapxitäna, ukat mä thaknam arkta.
Nayan saräwijajj intix jalantki uka chiqaruw puriyitu, ukanwa mä markar jikxatta.
Mä comunidadampiw jikista, jupanakax janiw arunak sum amuyapkänti, jupanakax pä qullunak taypin jakasipxäna.
Mä jarkʼaq lurañajatakiw mayipjjetäna, janiw naya pachpatak askïkänti, jan ukasti tʼunjir chʼamat jarkʼaqasiñatakiw mayipjjetäna.
Nayax yatiyawaytwa aka jach’a pirqa lurañataki ch’amax Allah tuqit juti, ukat mä arsut pachakamaw sayt’ani.
Nayan sutijajj ‘Pä wajjrani’ sasaw jaqokipasi, ukajj aka oraqer jan ukajj inas pä yaqha tiemponakar puritaj uñachtʼayi.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
